entities.summary: Stavtrup is a western suburb of Aarhus in Denmark. It is located 7 km from the city centre and had a population of 3,729. Since 1 January 2011, Stavtrup is officially a part of Aarhus' urban area under the postal district of Viby J. Stavtrup is a quarter in Northern Europe. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
